nodes.description: Privileged owner address set in the constructor from msg.sender; gates admin functions.
Public mapping of token balances, mutated without SafeMath in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping of spending allowances, decremented unchecked in transferFrom.
Per-address sale counter incremented on every transferFrom and checked in condition.
Whitelist mapping bypassing the sale condition checks in ensure.
Minimum sale amount used as a transfer gate; set in init.
Maximum sale amount used as a transfer gate; set in init.
Global maximum number of sales per address; set in init.
Whitelisted trading address that bypasses all sale restrictions in ensure.
Total token supply assigned in the constructor.
Constant decimals value (18) used for supply and sale scaling.
Token name.
Token symbol.
Hardcoded Uniswap router constant address that bypasses sale checks.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom.
Core transfer routine: allowance check, ensure gate, unchecked balance updates and _onSaleNum increment.
Whitelist bypass gate over owner, UNI, pair and tradeAddress, otherwise falls through to condition.
Sale restriction checks based on _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale.
Public allowance setter for msg.sender.
Owner-only function performing delegatecall to an arbitrary user supplied address and calldata.
Owner-only initializer computing unscaled multiplications for _minSale and _maxSale.
Owner-only batch transfer loop with unchecked total multiplication and balance decrement.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Internal pure function deriving the Uniswap pair address via keccak256.
Payable constructor that mints the entire supply to msg.sender and sets owner.
Caller controlled address used for ownership checks, allowance keys and balance accounting.
delegatecall execution in this contract's storage context with attacker supplied target and data.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value is executed without SafeMath and without a sufficient-balance invariant on the same statement.
balanceOf[_to] += _value unchecked addition that can overflow the recipient balance.
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total unchecked subtraction in batchSend.
total = _value * _tos.length unchecked multiplication that can overflow.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value unchecked subtraction in transferFrom.
_minSale = token * (10**uint256(decimals)) unchecked multiplication in init.
_maxSale = maxToken * (10**uint256(decimals)) unchecked multiplication in init.

edges.reason: delegate requires msg.sender == owner before performing the state-sensitive delegatecall.
init requires msg.sender == owner before modifying sale parameters.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before moving balances.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner before whitelisting an address.
msg.sender is compared against _from and used as the allowance spender key in transferFrom.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] using the caller address.
Constructor mints to and stores msg.sender.
msg.sender is assigned to the privileged owner state variable.
transfer forwards execution to transferFrom with msg.sender as source.
transferFrom calls ensure before mutating balances.
ensure falls back to condition when no whitelist branch matches.
transferFrom executes the unchecked balanceOf[_from] subtraction.
transferFrom executes the unchecked balanceOf[_to] addition.
transferFrom executes the unchecked allowance subtraction without SafeMath.
batchSend executes balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total without SafeMath.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length without overflow protection.
init computes _minSale = token * 10**decimals without SafeMath.
init computes _maxSale = maxToken * 10**decimals without SafeMath.
delegate performs a delegatecall to a caller supplied address and payload, executing arbitrary code in this contract's storage.
Attacker controlled _from selects the balance slot that is decremented.
_value is the subtrahend of the unchecked balance decrement.
_value is the addend of the unchecked recipient balance increment.
_from indexes the allowance mapping that is decremented.
_value is subtracted from the allowance entry.
_tos.length is a multiplier in the unchecked total computation.
_value multiplies the recipient count without overflow checks.
_value derived total is subtracted from the sender balance unchecked.
token parameter feeds the unchecked _minSale multiplication.
maxToken parameter feeds the unchecked _maxSale multiplication.
saleNum parameter is written to the _saleNum state variable.
token parameter determines the _minSale gate value.
maxToken parameter determines the _maxSale gate value.
addr parameter is written to the tradeAddress whitelist slot.
_to is the recipient passed through transfer.
_value is the amount passed through transfer.
_spender is the allowance key written in approve.
param a is the target address of the delegatecall.
param b is the arbitrary calldata of the delegatecall.
ensure reads the canSale whitelist to bypass restrictions.
ensure reads tradeAddress as an unconditional bypass branch.
condition reads the per-address _onSaleNum counter.
condition compares the transferred value against _minSale.
condition compares the transferred value against _maxSale.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] after moving balances.
factory address is encoded by pairFor.
tokenA is sorted and encoded by pairFor.
tokenB is sorted and encoded by pairFor.
Computed total is the subtrahend of the unchecked sender balance decrement.
Loop counter bounds the batchSend recipient iteration.
Loop-scoped recipient drives the balance increments in batchSend.
token0 participates in the pair hash computation.
token1 participates in the pair hash computation.

normalization_plan.reason: The recipient parameter only exists to satisfy the transfer entry point and should be folded into that function node.
The amount parameter's security-relevant use is the unchecked balance and allowance mutation it drives.
The source parameter's security-relevant use is as the index of the unchecked balance decrement.
The spender parameter is only meaningful as the key written by approve.
The target address parameter exists solely to feed the arbitrary delegatecall.
The calldata parameter exists solely to feed the arbitrary delegatecall.
The token parameter's only effect is the unchecked multiplication producing _minSale.
The maxToken parameter's only effect is the unchecked multiplication producing _maxSale.
The recipient array only contributes its length to the unchecked total multiplication.
The factory parameter is only hashed inside pairFor.
TokenA is only sorted and hashed inside pairFor.
TokenB is only sorted and hashed inside pairFor.
The local total is immediately subtracted from the sender balance in the unchecked decrement.
The loop counter has meaning only within the batchSend iteration.
The loop recipient is a transient variable scoped to the batchSend loop.
The sorted token variable is confined to the pairFor computation.
The sorted token variable is confined to the pairFor computation.
The computed pair address is the return value of pairFor and has no role elsewhere.
